name: Wild Isolation
source:
Since his mother died under mysterious circumstances, sinclair has been working tirelessly to uncover the truth. He doesn’t shy away from illegal activities, manipulation and seduction to root out conspiracies and corruption.

Depending on sinclair’s choices, he may find the truth behind his mother’s death, as well as a secret that is deeper and far more revolutionary.

[From[url=https://wildisolation.tumblr.com/page/5/]Official Website - Page 5[/url]]
translation:
自从母亲神秘去世后，辛克莱一直孜孜不倦地努力揭开真相。他并不回避非法活动、操纵和诱惑，以根除阴谋和腐败。

根据辛克莱的选择，他可能会发现母亲死亡背后的真相，以及一个更深层次、更具革命性的秘密。

[来自[url=https://wildisolation.tumblr.com/page/5/]官方网站 - 第5页[/url]]
